title: Compare upstream shop adapter on observed EUR list
platforms: Linux fork and upstream core comparison; GUI untested
changes: Check pinned upstream list recognition and scrollbar geometry against captured guest fields from the observed overflowing EUR shop.
validation: Upstream recognized 7 total and 4 visible, accepted scroll_to(3) without immediate guest-memory changes, and refused the request with mouse disabled. Geometry reached endpoints 0 and 3 with all four thumb positions round-tripping; protected inputs unchanged.
limitations: Transferred fields are not an upstream game session; no guest redraw, window event, native dispatch, replay, USA or Android test. Upstream core emitted four unused-code warnings and geometry probe one.
Managed cleanup accepts only target/rom-data-* and rejected this U31 unit; private evidence remains isolated.
